Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. questions.questionText: A nucleus collides with a stationary nucleus in a vacuum. The diagrams show the paths of the nuclei before and after the collision. No other particles are involved in the collision. Which diagram is not possible?

A uniform electric field is created by two parallel vertical plates. A positively charged particle is in the vacuum between the plates, as shown. – + positively – + charged – particle + – + – + – + – + – + Which statement is correct?

options.A: The electric field makes the particle move towards the negative plate with a constant speed.
options.B: The electric field makes the particle move towards the negative plate with a constant acceleration.
options.C: The electric field produces a uniform rate of decrease in the particle’s acceleration.
options.D: The electric field produces a uniform rate of increase in the particle’s acceleration.

questions.questionText: A picture is suspended from a nail by a single cord connected to two points X and Y on the picture. There is negligible friction between the cord and the nail so that the tension in both sides of the cord is the same. The picture hangs symmetrically, as shown. cord nail θ θ picture X Y The tension in the cord is T. The angle between the cord and the vertical is θ on both sides. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Increasing the length of the cord, with points X and Y in the same place on the picture, would reduce the tension in the cord.
options.B: Moving points X and Y further apart on the picture while keeping the length of the cord constant would reduce the tension in the cord.
options.C: Moving points X and Y to the top edge of the picture while keeping their distance apart constant and the length of the cord constant would reduce the tension in the cord.
options.D: The weight of the picture is equal to T cosθ.

options.B: the difference in displacement between a peak and a trough
options.C: the maximum displacement of a point on the wave from equilibrium

An elastic string is attached to an oscillator at one end and clamped at the other end so that the string is horizontal and in tension. The oscillator is made to oscillate vertically. The frequency of oscillation is gradually increased from zero until a stationary wave is set up in the string. The frequency is then increased further to frequency f, when a second stationary wave is set up in the string. The frequency is then increased further. At which frequency does a third stationary wave occur?

In an experiment, water waves in a ripple tank are incident on a gap, as shown. Some diffraction of the water waves is observed. Which change to the experiment would provide a better demonstration of diffraction?

options.B: Increase the frequency of the waves.
options.C: Increase the wavelength of the waves.
options.D: Increase the width of the gap.

questions.questionText: Light of wavelength λ is emitted from two point sources R and S and falls onto a distant screen. screen R P S (not to scale) At point P on the screen, the light intensity is zero. What could explain the zero intensity at P?

options.A: Light from the two sources is emitted 180° out of phase and the path difference to P is 1λ.
options.B: Light from the two sources is emitted in phase and the path difference to P is λ.
options.C: Light from the two sources is emitted 90° out of phase and the path difference to P is λ.
options.D: Light from the two sources is emitted in phase and the path difference to P is 1λ.
